testResults.name: controlled-provider-and-ingest-verification
testResults.result: Execution fca-ml-dev-ingest-rf36v8f completed with status Succeeded in 36 seconds using the deployed bounded command. It fetched real Alpaca AAPL data through the Key Vault-backed credentials, wrote 1,000 trade rows and 1,000 quote rows, and persisted both deterministic Parquet objects and partial coverage records
